title: GTA 6 Travis Scott Nike Air Force 1: $130, Sold Out, 5 Lessons
desc: The Travis Scott x GTA 6 Nike Air Force 1 listed at $130 in 3 colorways, all sold out at Cactus Jack. Prices, dates, the HEAT tie-in and 5 lessons for brands.
keywords: travis scott gta 6, gta 6 nike, gta 6 air force 1, travis scott air force 1 gta, cactus jack gta vi, nike cactus jack gta vi apparel, miami heat vice city, gta 6 merch, gta 6 brand collaboration, gta 6 sneakers
question: What was in the Travis Scott x GTA 6 Nike Air Force 1 drop, and what can brands learn from it?
cta: Planning a product drop? Automate the launch, waitlist and order rules for your store.
body:
Short answer. The Travis Scott x Rockstar Games x Nike "GTA 6" sneaker was an Air Force 1 sold in three colorways (white, black and a gradient camo) at $130 a pair, and all three were marked sold out on the Cactus Jack store when we checked on November 28, 2026. It was one of several releases and events timed around the game's November 19, 2026 launch, alongside a Rockstar Store collection, a Miami HEAT "Vice City" game night, a launch festival and two Nike apparel drops.

This guide sets out what was actually sold, where, when and for how much, using the sellers' own pages (the Cactus Jack store, Nike's SNKRS pages, the Miami HEAT and Rockstar Games), plus Sneaker News and Complex for details the sellers have not published. Then it turns the drop into five practical lessons for any brand that wants to sell around a big cultural moment. We do not cover resale prices, which vary by marketplace and are not published by the brands.

What Travis Scott, Nike and Rockstar released

Grand Theft Auto VI launched on November 19, 2026, according to Rockstar Newswire. Around that date, Travis Scott's Cactus Jack label, Nike and Rockstar Games put out one shared collection in three parts.

  • Three Air Force 1 pairs. The Cactus Jack store lists them as "Air Force 1 '07 RS" in Gradient Camo, White and Black, each at $130, and each marked sold out on November 28, 2026.
  • Nike apparel. The Nike SNKRS GTA VI apparel page says Cactus Jack, Nike and Rockstar Games partnered on a collection inspired by their Grand Theft Auto VI Air Force 1 collaborations. It lists two tees at $58 and two hoodies at $148.
  • A Miami HEAT capsule. The Nike SNKRS Miami HEAT page describes a lifestyle collection made by Cactus Jack with Nike, the Miami HEAT and Grand Theft Auto VI "to celebrate A Night in Vice City". It lists four pieces from $52 to $148.

According to Sneaker News (updated November 18, 2026), the white pair is patent leather with a reverse Swoosh, "GTA" replaces "Air" on the midsole, and a pink money band is included. The black pair has a debossed map, and the gradient pair was described as ultra limited.

Prices: what each piece cost

Every price below comes from the seller's own page, read on November 28, 2026. Prices are in US dollars, before tax and shipping.

Two sums make the spread clear. One of each Nike GTA VI piece costs $412 (two $58 tees plus two $148 hoodies), and one of each Miami HEAT piece on Nike costs $346. On the Cactus Jack store, GTA-named items run from the $50 hat to the $1,200 varsity jacket, so the top piece costs 24 times the cheapest. Our own arithmetic, from the listed prices.

The store also marks 8 GTA-named pieces as "cactusjack.com exclusive", including reflective windbreaker jackets at $160, windbreaker pants at $140 and a camo thermal zip hoodie at $195. Vice City swingman jerseys made with the Miami HEAT were listed as sold out.

When and where it went on sale

The collection did not drop in one place on one day. It was spread across six dates and at least four sellers.

  • October 8, 2026: Rockstar opened its own Grand Theft Auto VI Collection of tees, hats and collectibles, "exclusively available now at the Rockstar Store" (Rockstar Newswire, October 8, 2026).
  • November 18, 2026: the Miami HEAT hosted "A Night In Vice City" at Kaseya Center, the eve of the launch. The HEAT's A Night In Vice City page says the Nike x Cactus Jack "Vice City" uniform went on sale that night, and that the Cactus Jack collection was available from November 18 at the game, "including two arena-exclusive styles". Complex reported the HEAT played the Milwaukee Bucks.
  • November 19, 2026: the game launched.
  • November 21, 2026: the sneaker raffle opened on Nike SNKRS, as reported by Sneaker News and Complex. The same day, Rockstar's launch festival ran at Mana Wynwood in Miami with "Cactus Jack presents Travis Scott" on the lineup (Rockstar Newswire post of November 9, 2026).
  • November 23, 2026: the collection went on sale at cactusjack.com with extra exclusive styles, per Sneaker News.
  • November 24, 2026: Nike's data for both apparel pages shows a sale start of 10:00 a.m. ET on November 24, 2026.

We could not find a Nike SNKRS product page for the three shoes in Nike's public listings on November 28, 2026, and no seller has published how many pairs were made. Anyone quoting a pair count is guessing.

Five lessons for brands from the GTA 6 drop

You do not need a Rockstar budget to use the same playbook. These are our reading of the public record, not statements by Nike, Cactus Jack or Rockstar.

1. Tie the product to one date people already wait for

Every piece points at November 19, 2026. The HEAT night was set for the eve of launch, the festival two days after, and the sneakers and apparel within five days. People were already counting down; the products rode that attention instead of buying it. For a smaller brand, the moment can be a local event, a product launch in your niche or a season.

2. Sell where the fans already shop

Sneaker buyers check SNKRS, music fans follow Cactus Jack, basketball fans buy at the arena and gamers visit the Rockstar Store. Each partner sold to its own audience on its own storefront. A small brand can do the same with a partner's email list or store, instead of trying to pull everyone to one site.

3. Give each channel something only it has

The Cactus Jack store flags 8 GTA pieces as exclusive, the HEAT arena had two arena-only styles, and the Rockstar Store collection was exclusive to Rockstar. Exclusives give each partner a reason to promote the drop and give fans a reason to visit more than one store.

4. Make it local and physical

The game is set in a Miami-inspired state, and the HEAT turned that into a real night: a one-night "Vice City" court, game cars on the plaza, in-game fast food brands Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell at named concession stands, and a Nike x Cactus Jack "Vice City" uniform that went on sale at the event. A local tie-in turns a product into an event people photograph and share.

5. Price a ladder, not one item

The range ran from a $50 hat to $1,200 for the varsity jacket, with $58 tees, $130 shoes and $148 hoodies in between. In our view, the scarce item (the sneaker) draws attention, while the wider price range gives more people something they can buy. No seller has published sales figures, but if your top product sells out, a ladder gives the remaining traffic somewhere to go.

Buying safely after a sold-out drop

Sold-out drops are a common target for fake stores and fake raffles, much like the GTA 6 early access scams we covered before launch. A few rules help buyers stay safe:

  1. Buy only from the official sellers named above: Nike SNKRS on nike.com, the Cactus Jack store at shop.travisscott.com, the Miami HEAT Store and the Rockstar Store.
  2. Ignore messages that say you "won" a raffle you never entered or that ask for a fee to claim a pair.
  3. Check the web address before you sign in. A look-alike domain with a GTA 6 or Travis Scott name in it is a warning sign.
  4. If you buy resale, use a marketplace with buyer protection and authentication, and pay by card rather than bank transfer or gift card.

What this means for online stores

For a store owner, the useful part of this story is the plumbing: timed launches, per-channel exclusives, a quantity limit per order and clear sold-out labels. Nike's product data for the GTA VI apparel shows a quantity limit of 10. Those features exist on most commerce platforms, including Shopify. faqs: How much was the Travis Scott GTA 6 Air Force 1?
The Cactus Jack store lists each of the three Air Force 1 '07 RS pairs at $130. On November 28, 2026 all three colorways, White, Black and Gradient Camo, were marked sold out.
When did the Travis Scott GTA 6 Nike shoes release?
Sneaker News and Complex reported a Nike SNKRS raffle on November 21, 2026 and a cactusjack.com release on November 23, 2026, two and four days after GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026.
Is the Travis Scott GTA 6 collection still available?
On November 28, 2026 the sneakers were sold out. Some Nike GTA VI tees and hoodies ($58 and $148) still had sizes on Nike SNKRS, and the Cactus Jack store still listed apparel.
What is in the Nike Cactus Jack x GTA VI apparel collection?
Nike SNKRS lists a 6 Stars Tee and a Wanted Reflective Tee at $58 each, and Money Band and VI Palms Logo Reflective Hoodies at $148 each, on sale from November 24, 2026.
What was A Night in Vice City?
A Miami HEAT home game at Kaseya Center on November 18, 2026, the eve of GTA 6's launch, with a Vice City court, game cars, in-game food brands and a Nike x Cactus Jack Vice City uniform for sale.
How many pairs of the GTA 6 Air Force 1 were made?
Nike, Cactus Jack and Rockstar have not published a number. Sneaker News described the gradient pair as ultra limited, but any exact pair count you see is not from the sellers.
